concerns.text: FR-001 requires the presence of 'outcome, predictors, covariates' in the GateMem dataset, but the GateMem dataset (as described in the Assumptions and the original GateMem paper) contains only `leak-target` annotations and role definitions. This makes the requirement unimplementable and contradicts the dataset description.

Functional requirements FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, and FR-007 all reference user stories as 'US-1', 'US-2', 'US-3', but the specification labels them 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', 'User Story 3'. The referenced IDs do not exist, breaking traceability.
